description: The top of the library, organized like a university: faculties contain departments, and each department opens onto the concept decks beneath it. Below this level the structure comes from the concept tree itself: any concept with children is a deck.

faculties.title: Me
faculties.blurb: Beliefs, fascinations, and lessons, in my own words.

departments.title: Entropy
departments.blurb: The idea I keep coming back to, and everything that hangs off it.

departments.title: Taoism, Care & Letting Go
departments.blurb: Helping without forcing, boundaries, and living with regret.

departments.title: Studying in Japan
departments.blurb: The whole journey as a chain, start to finish: choosing a path, the MEXT application, the visa, and settling in.

departments.title: Networks & Communications

departments.title: Security
